item.title: Objectives of Life - puruShArtha and karma
item.description:
Objectives of Life - puruShArtha and karma Ram Chandran

Source: TW

Author: Ram Chandran

Ram Chandran is the owner of the Advaitin EGroup and maintains an extensive website on behalf of the group.

The following was posted to the Advaitin Egroup in Dec 2003.

The scriptures declare four goals in human life and they are called the puruShArtha-s. The term ‘puruShArtha’ not only denotes what the objectives of life should be but it also means what the objectives of life are as the result of the psychological tendencies of the individual. The puruShArtha-s consist of dharma, Artha, kAma and mokSha in the same order.

item.title: Truth, Appearance and Reality
item.description:
Truth, Appearance and Reality Ram Chandran

Source: TW

Author: Ram Chandran

Ram Chandran is the owner of the Advaitin EGroup and maintains an extensive website on behalf of the group.

The following was posted to the Advaitin Egroup in Dec 2003.

Everything that we do is at the vyAvahArika level only and even the description and explanation of pAramArthika are also at the vyAvahArika level.

No one except Brahman knows what the pAramArthika level is and even this assertion is only at the vyAvahArika level. The sages and saints are always careful and they have avoided making any false claims. Our problem is the lack of understanding of what they say and most of the time, we attribute our mistakes as theirs.
